results.name: Peer Review
results.description:
Multi-model peer review layer using local LLMs via Ollama to catch errors in cloud model output.
Fan-out critiques to 2-3 local models, aggregate flags, synthesize consensus.

Use when: validating trade analyses, reviewing agent output quality, testing local model accuracy,
checking any high-stakes Claude output before publishing or acting on it.

Don't use when: simple fact-checking (just search the web), tasks that don't benefit from
multi-model consensus, time-critical decisions where 60s latency is unacceptable,
reviewing trivial or low-stakes content.

Negative examples:
- "Check if this date is correct" → No. Just web search it.
- "Review my grocery list" → No. Not worth multi-model inference.
- "I need this answer in 5 seconds" → No. Peer review adds 30-60s latency.

Edge cases:
- Short text (<50 words) → Models may not find meaningful issues. Consider skipping.
- Highly technical domain → Local models may lack domain knowledge. Weight flags lower.
- Creative writing → Factual review doesn't apply well. Use only for logical consistency.

rejected.github: Existing role-owned GitHub workflows suffice; current bundled helper reads credential stores, so do not import it.
rejected.jupyter-notebook: Reject unauthenticated server/XSRF-disable guidance and non-profile helper checkout; native execute_code already preserves state.
rejected.impeccable: Reject catalog-only stub and floating first-run executable downloads; use reviewed design-md and existing design workflows.
rejected.memento-flashcards: Reject persistence inside skill code tree and global-profile paths; existing teaching/retention workflows suffice.
rejected.godot-3d-essentials: Inspected public Apache-2.0 source at 19d93f97c9c1ea0f8b306e77aa81e0d3e352d3e9; targets Godot 4.7 and overlaps existing scene/level skills. Keep version-specific official engine documentation through native web lookup.
rejected.hyperframes: Reject global npm setup/floating binaries as a portable default; retain existing video-edit/export workflows.
rejected.fitness-nutrition: Broad coach persona and body metrics overlap current Council skills; retain evidence-first coaching rather than add redundant authority.
rejected.community-security-best-practices: Role-owned security skills and native Hermes security scans already cover general review; no additional overriding language policy.
rejected.generic-personal-domain-skills: Retain existing narrow coaching skills rather than import competing personas, regulated advice or third-party storage.
rejected.autonomous-orchestration-plugins: Native delegation/cron/kanban already exist; no new control plane or unsolicited automation.
